_comment: Cloudera AI Inference for the OGX Agentic Integrity Monitor (agents/, agent_app/). The service runs on its own compute cluster in federal-cdp-env; GPU node groups scale from zero, so only a deployed endpoint costs GPU time. OGX_CAII_BASE_URL / OGX_CAII_MODEL override the endpoint below; the token is the CDP JWT (/tmp/jwt inside CAI, OGX_CAII_TOKEN or the cdp CLI elsewhere).
